_doc: Per-iteration re-OCR instrumentation schema (OriginalDR QC contract). The double-bind audit (qc_audit.py -> coverage-audit.json) records a per-locus x per-source verdict for ONE state of the corpus. This schema defines the SUPERSET record that every re-OCR ITERATION PHASE must emit so the whole trajectory (baseline -> archaic-preeminent verse-grain -> P3 layout-aware re-OCR -> P4 apparatus -> vision-LLM rung) is captured uniformly and the statistical report (build_reocr_report.py) can render exhaustive cross-phase comparisons without re-deriving anything. Each iteration appends an array of `iteration_record`s tagged with a `phase`. coverage-audit.json is the chapter-grain projection of the P2-baseline phase; its per-source dicts already carry the identity core (modern_id/archaic_id/passed/...). Fields marked instrument@P3 are NOT yet populated (baseline OCR was not cost-instrumented) and MUST be captured when the re-OCR ladder runs.
grain_note: REVISED 2026-07-10 (Sir): uniform verse/element grain is the target. locus.grain records the grain the record was actually scored at, so chapter-grain baseline records and verse-grain reworked records coexist honestly in one file and the report never silently conflates them.

phase_enum.P2-baseline: Diplomatic OCR as-is, chapter-grain concat, modern-primary AND-gate. The current coverage-audit.json. method=diplomatic-ocr-existing.
phase_enum.P2-archaic-preeminent: Same OCR, re-scored under archaic-preeminent gating (Sir 2026-07-10 sec 1.4). Chapter-grain until the verse-grain rework (tasks 8-10) lands; then re-emitted at verse grain.
phase_enum.P3-rung1-baseline-kraken: Re-OCR, escalation rung 1: baseline kraken segmentation.
phase_enum.P3-rung2-layout-aware: Re-OCR rung 2: layout-aware segmentation (column detect, verse-line, marginal/inline-annotation separation).
phase_enum.P3-rung4-vision-llm: Re-OCR rung 4: multimodal vision-LLM page reading (the costly rung; cost fields REQUIRED).

governing_gate_enum.archaic: archaic_ref exists at locus -> PASS iff archaic_id >= threshold (+ long-s rule). modern_id recorded as signal only.
governing_gate_enum.modern: no archaic_ref -> PASS iff modern_id >= threshold. The ONLY place the modern gate governs.
governing_gate_enum.needs-reference: neither reference present -> loud OPEN alert; never a silent pass or park (No Silent Degradation).

captured_at.desc: ISO-8601 UTC when this record was scored.

grain.desc: Grain this record was scored at. Target = verse/element; chapter allowed only for the baseline projection.

source.desc: Witness id (S1..S15, sabates_a, madueke_b, s_dismas, odr_com).

best_raster.desc: Raster tier scored: jp2-master | pdf-content | eebo-scan. instrument@P3.

method.desc: How this OCR text was produced for THIS attempt (the escalation rung).

localized.desc: FORWARD gate step 1: anchors found AND contiguous span.

modern_id.desc: char-level identity (normalized Levenshtein, both sides modern-folded) vs modern_ref. null for transcriptions (they ARE references).

archaic_id.desc: char-level identity (both sides s-folded) vs archaic_ref. null where no archaic_ref.

archaic_rule_pass.desc: Reference-free long-s placement rule (R12). Auxiliary s-conformance signal; the gate where no archaic_ref exists.

f_to_s_suspect.desc: OCR with no s-long but f in initial/medial s-positions -> suspected s->f misread; route to re-OCR. instrument@P3.

modern_pass.desc: modern_id >= threshold (recorded regardless of whether modern governs).

archaic_pass.desc: archaic_id >= threshold (or rule_pass where no ref).

passed.desc: Final verdict under the GOVERNING gate. archaic-preeminent: passed = archaic_pass if archaic_ref_exists else modern_pass.

witness_count.desc: BACKWARD gate: passing witnesses at this locus.

E_v.desc: Expected witness count for the locus (source-index loci_ev).

shortfall_flag.desc: witness_count < E_v. A shortfall locus stays OPEN and blocks ship; never parked.

cost_pages.desc: Pages OCR'd for this attempt. instrument@P3.

cost_seconds.desc: Wall-clock seconds for this attempt. instrument@P3.

cost_usd.desc: Direct $ if measurable; null by design where only utilization fractions exist.

text_sha256.desc: sha256 of the exact OCR surface text scored -> provenance / dedup across attempts. instrument@P3.

identity_bar.metric: normalized-Levenshtein (difflib.ratio in the P2-baseline artifact; metric swap pending per plan sec1.4)

report_consumption: build_reocr_report.py reads coverage-audit.json (P2-baseline projection) plus any number of phase files named coverage-audit.<phase>.json, unions their records keyed by (phase, locus, source), and renders per-phase panels + cross-phase delta plots. Adding a phase requires NO report change: drop a conforming file in the dir.
